All effects are silent at 0%
All effects are silent while SFX is OFF
Real AudioContext explosion produces finite audible output
Prominent weapon sound ducks selected background-music volume

Quiet movement feedback does not repeatedly duck background music
Real AudioContext SFX 0% remains silent
Real AudioContext SFX OFF remains silent
Jetpack engine remains audible while thrust is active
Jetpack loop ends when flight ends
Drill motor remains audible throughout the active drill projectile
Drill loop ends when its projectile disappears
stopSFX removes both scheduled effects and continuous engines
Switching SFX OFF during thrust removes the continuous sound
Enabling SFX restores an active engine through the state update
Trusted pause button stops all active audio effects
Paused gameplay cannot recreate effect voices
Resume restores only currently active continuous effects
Restart removes previous audio events and continuous engines
Completed one-shot voices are removed after their envelopes end
Repeated movement and overlapping weapons keep voice and node counts bounded
Sound variation does not consume the gameplay Math.random sequence
Suspending AudioContext releases continuous and scheduled sources
Resuming AudioContext does not replay stale effects
Closed AudioContext is recreated with the decoded music buffer retained
Recreated AudioContext can output a new weapon effect
No browser JavaScript errors during audio verification

scope: Real Edge AudioContext output and controlled OfflineAudioContext synthesis. Physical speaker listening and perceptual similarity to original game audio are not verified.
